hints.title: Prefix Sum Representation
hints.text: Construct a prefix sum array of character score values to evaluate any substring sum in constant time.

hints.title: Even Substring Windows
hints.text: Iterate through even lengths 2k and compare the sum of the first k characters with the next k characters.

hints.title: Constant Query
hints.text: Range sums [start, start + k) and [start + k, start + 2k) take constant time via prefix differences.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix sum array allows constant time substring score evaluations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing characters repeatedly per candidate substring requires O(N^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 1D prefix sums for constant time range comparisons.
